get.summary: List bookable community visit occurrences (communityId) or legacy branch slots (branchId)
get.description: Canonical vendor-scoped availability. Prefer communityId with fromDate/toDate (or date) to return bookable dated community visit occurrences. Pass communityId+serviceId+date for service-visit time slices. branchId+date remains supported for legacy clients.
